source.title: Harba, Badia & Serrancolí · Grand Challenge walking recordings
source.coordinateConvention: OpenSim laboratory X/Y/Z with +Y up. Overground playback faces +X; the treadmill participant faces −X. The clip heading is the sign of the first pelvis forward axis projected on laboratory X. Each clip subtracts its own initial pelvis X/Z position from the motions and center of pressure. Quaternions are [x, y, z, w].
source.frameConvention: Flat 7 values per segment in segmentOrder, equally spaced in phase. A stride spans consecutive right-foot 20 N crossings and a stance-only clip ends at right toe-off. Force study waveforms cover the interval from initial contact to stanceEndPct.
source.groundConvention: A known plate/belt contact returns [CoP x, y, z in meters, force x, y, z in body weights] in world axes. Right uses overground plates 2/3 or treadmill belt 2; left uses plate/belt 1. Null means no measured contact above 20 N, including parts of overground recordings outside the plates.
notes: Positions and orientations come from the released whole-body OpenSim fit to recorded movement. The released model includes body geometry for a rigid torso and hands, including reference skull and fingers where rendered. Head and individual finger movement have no independent recorded channels.
The source knee joint has secondary fitted or constrained coordinates. Knee angles follow the native model here; the detailed tissue inset uses its own atlas rig and sagittal angle only.

Overground second stances lack a following measured right initial contact. Those clips preserve observed stance only. Whole cycle clips start from the first right stance available for each gait condition.
